_metadata.texto_original: Allonzo is a werewolf who has been turned into a vampire. Thoroughly insane, he now serves the Wyrm. Allonzo can use Shadow Lords, Metis and Black Spiral Dancer Gifts. He cannot be alpha 2 turns in a row.
